item.title: Text changed
item.description: Path: Query API > Registration > Individual Registration Validation Details > Dataset Details --- previous +++ current @@ -2,3 +2,4 @@ The scope of individuals included in this dataset include: All active registered individuals who are currently registered with a broker-dealer (inclusive of individuals registered as both RR & IAR) All those who were active in last 10 years All those who where active for over 10 years but have certain types of disclosure that require them being on BrokerCheck permanently IA Only registered individuals are not included in this dataset. +Changes to individual records are reflected in the endpoint response after 8 AM the following business day, Monday through Saturday, and after 9 AM on Sunday. The request will return either a 404 error code, if the individual CRD# is not found/invalid

item.title: Text changed
item.description: Path: Query API > Registration > Individual Registration Validation > Dataset Details --- previous +++ current @@ -1,4 +1,5 @@ This endpoint allows FINRA member firms, as well as other financial services industry participants (e.g. insurance companies, mutual fund organizations, transfer agents, clearing firms, service providers, and FinTech solution providers) to validate the registration status of an individual, regardless of the individual's firm affiliation. The scope of individuals included in this dataset include active registered individuals who are currently registered with a broker-dealer (inclusive of individuals registered as both RR & IAR). IA Only registered individuals are not included in this dataset. +Changes to individual records are reflected in the endpoint response after 8 AM the following business day, Monday through Saturday, and after 9 AM on Sunday. This endpoint follows the Single Record Dataset structure: /data/group/{group name}/name/{dataset name}/id/{id} where the {id} field represents and individual CRD number. The request will return either a 404 error code, if the individual CRD# is not found/invalid, or a response payload containing the following information for a valid CRD#:

item.title: Text changed
item.description: Path: Getting Started > On Behalf Of > Implementation Workflow --- previous +++ current @@ -26,5 +26,13 @@ Create the OBO API credential Use this credential to access data or perform filings on behalf of the firm -Note: The OBO credential will be visible to both the Prime (vendor) and the firm. The firm can view it under the OBO Credential tab in their API Console. Additionally, the total PAID credential limit per firm/org has been increased from five to seven, which includes OBO credentials. +Note: +The OBO credential will be visible to both the Prime (vendor) and the firm. The firm can view it under the OBO Credential tab in their API Console. Additionally, the total PAID credential limit per firm/org has been increased from five to seven, which includes OBO credentials. +The firm must also maintain an active Firm credential to support the OBO credential. This credential does not need to be shared with the vendor. QA Test Environment -Once the OBO relationship is established in production and OBO API credentials are created, you can create an OBO relationship in the QA Test environment if needed. To do so, click the "Chat with us" button on the bottom right to contact support. +Once the OBO relationship and API credentials are established in production, the vendor or third party may contact API Platform Support to set up the OBO relationship in the QA Test environment. To do so, provide the following: +vendorOrgId +vendorOrgName +vendorEmail +firmOrgId +firmOrgName +Note: The firm must also be onboarded to the QA Test environment and maintain an active Firm credential to support the OBO credential. This credential does not need to be shared with the vendor.
